name: trend check v0.3, pre-registered secondary: shares by start year (reduced)
source: ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 search (data from the US National Library of Medicine), countTotal of query.term = AREA[StudyType]INTERVENTIONAL AND AREA[StartDate]RANGE[<year>-01-01,<year>-12-31] AND AREA[Phase]NA AND AREA[EligibilityCriteria]<phrase, or an OR of a family's wordings as in trend_check.criteria>
note: Reduced version of the per-year secondary of prereg-v0.3.json: no-phase trials only, the three families and the 9 controls that the 20-match rule keeps there (H1). 2008 and 2025 are the counts of prereg-v0.3-counts.json; 2009-2024 were fetched in one run on 2026-10-15, after the 2008 no-phase total (3,474) and hearing count (49) were re-fetched and matched. The all-trials and other-trials strata, the 14 left-out controls and the reference phrase were not counted by year. CC BY 4.0. Counted by MV2 of Munim, Inc. with AI agents.
